name: Shri Keshav Cements and Infra Limited
about: Shri Keshav Cements and Infra Limited manufactures and trades in cements in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Cements; Petrol and Diesel; and Solar Energy. The company offers cements under the Keshav Cement and Jyoti Cement brand names for heavy-duty construction; concrete slabs, foundation, and walls; dams, canals, bridges, concrete roads, and other public utilities; and buildings. It also engages in the trading of petroleum products; and generation and distribution of solar energy. The company was formerly known as Katwa Udyog Limited and changed its name to Shri Keshav Cements and Infra Limited in November 2007. Shri Keshav Cements and Infra Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Belgaum, India.
